execution.raw_text:
{
  "up": "Select molecule_chembl_id as compound_chembl_id, child.standard_inchi_key as canonical_smiles, compound_records.compound_key as compound_key, docs.pubmed_id as pubmed_id_or_doi, assays.description as assay_description, activities.standard_type, activities.standard_relation, activities.standard_value, activities.standard_units, activities.activity_comment, target_dictionary.chembl_id as target_chembl_id, target_dictionary.pref_name as target_name, target_dictionary.organism as target_organism
Join molecule_dictionary parent on parent.chembl_id = 'CHEMBL2403108'
Join molecule_hierarchy mh on mh.parent_molregno = parent.molregno
Join molecule_dictionary child on child.molregno = mh.molregno
Left Join compound_records on child.molregno = compound_records.molregno
Left Join docs on compound_records.doc_id = docs.doc_id
Join activities on compound_records.record_id = activities.record_id
Join assays on activities.assay_id = assays.assay_id
Join target_dictionary on activities.tid = target_dictionary.tid
Filter activities.bao_endpoint = 'IC50' and activities.standard_relation = '=' and activities.standard_value is not null and activities.standard_units = 'nM' and assays.assay_organism = 'Homo sapiens' and target_dictionary.chembl_id = 'CHEMBL4247'
Return compound_chembl_id, canonical_smiles, compound_key, pubmed_id_or_doi, assay_description, standard_type, standard_relation, standard_value, standard_units, activity_comment, target_chembl_id, target_name, target_organism
Sort by compound_chembl_id, compound_key, pubmed_id_or_doi, assay_description, standard_type, standard_relation, standard_value, standard_units, target_chembl_id, target_name, target_organism"
}
